item_name: Rothco A Positive Blood Type Morale Patch
item_short_desc: Be prepared for any situation with Rothco Blood Type Morale Patches. Designed for quick and easy identification, these tactical patches let medics know your blood type at a glance. Measuring 2" x 1", each patch features a durable hook backing for secure attachment to any loop field, making them ideal for tactical gear, backpacks, or uniforms. Stay mission-ready with this essential and highly visible accessory.
